run_pybullet_gui_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a URDF robot model and renders camera images in a loop
connect_pybullet_client: connect to the pybullet physics simulator in GUI mode using p.connect(p.GUI)
load_urdf_model: load a URDF robot model into the pybullet simulator with a fixed base using p.loadURDF
capture_camera_image: capture a camera image from the pybullet simulator at a specified resolution using p.getCameraImage
set_realtime_simulation: enable real-time simulation mode in pybullet using p.setRealTimeSimulation(1)
